item.title: Hell Jump Chapter 4 & Update 2.0 Progress Update - October 2026
Hell Jump Chapter 4 & Update 2.0 Progress Update - October 2026
item.description:
Hi everyone!

Another month has passed, which means it's time for another Hell Jump development update! I'm writing this pretty late at night, so please excuse any questionable grammar. :)

New and Shiny Things
A few things have happened outside of the main Chapter 4 development:

- Supporter Edition is in development!
- Code quality improvements, thanks to Wolfyxon.
- Original music composed by KaroleusPL.

Speaking of KaroleusPL, I genuinely appreciate you making music for Hell Jump without asking for payment. It means a lot to me. Thank you! <3

But wait, what's the Supporter Edition?
The Supporter Edition is a way for players to support Hell Jump financially while getting a few extra perks in return.

You'll be able to purchase Hell Jump on itch.io for $1 or more and link your purchase to the game. This will unlock some additional features, including:

- No advertisements on mobile.
- A special thank-you in the credits.
- Access to a secret location.
- And potentially a few more surprises...

And before anyone asks: THE BASE GAME WILL ALWAYS BE FREE! The Supporter Edition is entirely optional. I don't want to lock the actual game behind a paywall.

What happened to me?
Some people in my Discord server might have noticed that I temporarily paused my work on Hell Jump.

The reason is that I joined Core Mechanics Fall 2026 so I've been spending some of my development time working on that project, so Hell Jump's development has temporarily been taken over by Wolfyxon.

He's been helping with development and code quality, and honestly, at this point, he might as well be considered a main developer!

BUT DUDE, WHAT ABOUT MIDDLE HEAVEN?!
Don't worry, Middle Heaven hasn't been abandoned!

Development has actually made some pretty good progress. We've been working on new bosses and expanding the content planned for Chapter 4.

I've also done some development alongside Wolfyxon using the GodotTogether plugin, which lets us collaborate directly inside Godot.

There's still plenty of work ahead, but things are moving forward!

That's all for October!
Thank you to everyone who continues to play Hell Jump, support the project, report bugs, and follow its development. Every bit of support means a lot.

See you in the next update. Cześć!

- AramCZ

item.title: Hell Jump Chapter 4 & Update 2.0 Progress Update - October 2026
item.description:
Heya! It's been almost a month, so things have happened. If you follow the @HellJumpGame Twitter account, you may have noticed that activity has gone down. That's because I started school. :( Work hasn't been too bad, but development has slowed down a bit.

New and Shiny
Hell Jump will now have Discord Rich Presence! When you're in a level and signed in to Discord, your Discord profile will show that you're playing Hell Jump. You'll also be able to disable this feature in the settings.

Discord Rich Presence will also display which level you're currently playing.

New and Smaller Shiny Things
- A master volume slider
- Textboxes
- Better Git history
- And a few more things

You forgot about Middle Heaven!
Not much progress has been made on Middle Heaven this month. I focused more on adding quality-of-life features instead of working on the new chapter. However, some help with level design came from Wolfyxon.

How will Middle Heaven be released?
Middle Heaven will be released as part of Update 2.0, completely free.

One last thing: I created a Discord Server! It's not all about Hell Jump, but there is a channel dedicated to it. If you want to check it out, click the "Discord Server" link above.

That's all for now. Čau.

-AramCZ

item.title: Hell Jump Chapter 4 Progress Update - September 2026
item.description:
Hell Jump Chapter 4 is now in development! We're hoping that this chapter will be really good. Currently, only Level 36 is finished.

We also have a new ending visual. Some help with it came from Wolfyxon. He's a cool guy!

That's all for now. We're currently working on a secret project that is coming this century.

-AramCZ
